Deep proficiency in C++ with advanced expertise in multi-threaded programming, concurrency control, and low-level system optimizations. Extensive background in modern cloud storage infrastructure, disaster recovery (DR), data replication protocols, or block storage snapshot methodologies. About the job Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. Persistent Disk (PD) Snapshot team delivers foundational data protection and disaster recovery solutions for Google Cloud’s Persistent Disk (PD). We are responsible for PD Snapshots and Instant Snapshots-critical backup primitives ensuring business continuity for global enterprises. While standard PD Snapshots offer highly durable, geo-redundant storage in Google Cloud Storage (GCS), Instant Snapshots provide ultra-fast, in-place checkpoints for rapid recovery. Our mission is to build the most reliable, scalable, and high-performance data protection infrastructure in the cloud, helping customers seamlessly guard against data loss with minimal downtime. In this role, you will manage distributed storage and metadata challenges at exabyte scale, directly impacting the reliability and trustworthiness of Google Cloud Platform for millions of users worldwide.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. Responsibilities Act as a critical technical leader setting the strategy, roadmap, and architectural direction for Google Cloud's backup and disaster recovery primitives. Be responsible for managing large, highly ambiguous problems where the path forward is unclear, reducing chaos, and building consensus across multiple cross-functional teams. Lead the evolution of PD Snapshots and Instant snapshots to support exponential growth, driving multi-quarter initiatives exabyte-scale data routing, metadata isolation, and zero-latency in-place backup mechanisms. Be a multiplier who advocates product excellence, drives system reliability, and mentors executive and junior engineers alike to achieve ambitious milestones at global scale. Align stakeholders, peer teams, and executive leaders across PD Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and Product Manager (PM) on critical design and integration decisions. review_candidates.description: Astroscale France is looking for a Flight Software Engineer (M/F) This role with significant technical ownership will focus on the design, development and validation of safety-critical Flight Software enabling autonomous rendezvous, proximity operations (RPO), and robotic servicing missions, including debris removal and life extension. You’ll join a team developing cutting-edge autonomous spacecraft performing complex in-orbit operations that have not yet been achieved at commercial scale. 🛰️Responsibilities : Flight Software Design, develop and validate onboard Flight Software for Astroscale spacecraft, ensuring deterministic real-time execution under constrained onboard resources. Define and maintain software interfaces (ICDs) with spacecraft subsystems. Contribute to and influence the onboard software architecture and hardware-software partitioning. Implement robust fault detection, isolation, and recovery (FDIR) mechanisms. Develop and execute Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test campaigns in support of mission validation. Wider responsibilities Liaise with GNC and Computer Vision teams to integrate their work on the Flight Software. Support coordination of Flight Software activities across subsystem teams to ensure coherent system integration. Attend and support reviews with potential partners or clients. Support knowledge transfer across Astroscale teams globally. 🚀 Expected results Deliver Flight Software that meets mission performance, safety, and reliability requirements. Achieve successful integration with spacecraft subsystems and mission simulations. Contribute to on-time delivery of Flight Software for mission milestones (e.g. PDR, CDR, launch readiness). 🧑‍🚀Experience And Qualifications Required Essential: Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, or relevant engineering / science discipline. 5 years’ experience in software development for real-time embedded systems (C/C++). Experience designing deterministic, multi-threaded real-time software. Knowledge of hardware solutions and hardware interfacing (drivers). Experience with software version control systems (e.g. Git) and continuous integration pipelines (e.g. Gitlab). Strong debugging skills across software, hardware interfaces, and system-level interactions. Proactive and self-managing, able to plan and effectively lead areas of responsibility whilst contributing collaboratively within a close-knit team. Fluent in French and English Be eligible and registered to work within Europe Desirable: Experience developing software for the aerospace sector, including on platforms such as VxWorks or RTEMS. Experience across all stages of the mission design lifecycle, from initial concept through design, test, and operations. Familiarity with UML. Familiarity with commonly used protocols and standards for communications, such as CCSDS, CAN, Spacewire. Knowledge of the cFS software framework. Development on Linux-based systems. ⚙️ Core competencies Demonstrates behaviours in line with Astroscale values (mission and people focused, transparent, innovative and pioneering, diverse and customer focused). Proactive, able to build working relationships, mentoring & knowledge sharing Location Astroscale France (Toulouse), with some hybrid working What we offer At Astroscale, we believe that when people feel supported, they can focus on achieving extraordinary things. Premium family health insurance (Mutuelle) 100% funded by the company 100% employer-funded disability & life insurance coverage (Pervoyance) Salary maintained from day one of sick leave Hybrid working (up to 2 days remote per week) Remote work allowance Paid child sickness leave Additional family and caregiving leave About Astroscale Astroscale is the global leader in on-orbit servicing, dedicated to the secure and sustainable development of space.
